subject.title: fix(ssrf): re-check resolved addresses for proxy/redirect paths

question: Should strict proxy-mode guarded fetches resolve target DNS locally before dispatch, even though current proxy-only behavior intentionally lets the proxy resolve the host?
rationale: This is a security-versus-compatibility boundary: the proposed hardening can fail closed for existing proxy-only users, and accepting that tradeoff needs owner intent rather than an automated repair guess.

options.title: Preserve Proxy-Owned DNS
options.body: Require a revised fix that keeps managed/trusted proxy paths working when local target DNS is unavailable and adds focused fetch-guard regression proof.

options.title: Approve Fail-Closed DNS
options.body: Accept the compatibility break only with explicit maintainer approval, updated tests/docs, and upgrade proof for proxy-only environments.

options.title: Close This Approach
options.body: Close or replace this PR if local DNS cannot provide meaningful protection against proxy-side DNS rebinding without breaking proxy-only users.

recommendation.title: Preserve Proxy-Owned DNS
recommendation.body: Require a revised fix that keeps managed/trusted proxy paths working when local target DNS is unavailable and adds focused fetch-guard regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the guarded-fetch SSRF dispatcher boundary and related proxy hardening.
